claims.text: Adding 5–10 wt% MoS2 powder to an HEA by powder metallurgy is the proposed intervention.
The MoS2-containing HEA will have a coefficient of friction at least 30% lower than the untreated HEA from room temperature to 600°C.
The MoS2-containing HEA will have a wear rate at least 40% lower than the untreated HEA from room temperature to 600°C.
Powder-metallurgy processing will produce uniformly dispersed MoS2 particles in the HEA matrix.
MoS2 particles can undergo tribochemical reactions and form a tribofilm at the sliding interface.
MoS2 shears easily under load.
MoS2 forms a low-shear-strength tribofilm at the contact interface.
The tribofilm reduces adhesive interactions at the sliding interface.
The tribofilm reduces abrasive interactions at the sliding interface.
Reduced adhesive and abrasive interactions lower friction.
Reduced adhesive and abrasive interactions lower wear.
The HEA matrix provides mechanical support to the solid-lubricant phase.
The HEA matrix provides thermal stability over the proposed service-temperature range.
The MoS2 phase maintains lubricity from room temperature to 600°C.
The proposed effect applies during dry sliding against steel or ceramic counterfaces under loads typical of self-lubricating components.
MoS2 oxidation may diminish effectiveness above 600°C.
Embrittlement may diminish effectiveness below -50°C.
Adding more than 15 wt% MoS2 may compromise mechanical integrity.
A controlled pin-on-disk experiment will compare an HEA containing 7 wt% MoS2 with an untreated HEA at room temperature, 300°C, and 600°C.
Failure to obtain at least a 20% reduction in both friction and wear at every tested temperature, or failure to detect a lubricious tribofilm, is designated as falsifying the hypothesis.

contradictions.description: The prediction requires at least 30% lower friction and 40% lower wear, but the falsification rule only requires 20% reductions. Results between these thresholds would fail the stated prediction without falsifying the hypothesis, so the decisive criterion is inconsistent with the quantitative prediction.
